notes: Mid-market B2B search SaaS: multi-tenant knowledge search for product help + account docs.

Priority constraints: p95 embedding latency < 500ms for online API; nightly batch of ~3M docs must finish within 4 hours (throughput target ~12.5k docs/min).
Model preferences: open-model embeddings compatible with Redwood; willing to test quantized L2 variants for cost savings.
Routing: need ability to route low-cost bulk batch to cheaper capacity while keeping online routing to low-latency cluster.
Security: must pass SOC2 + SSO/SAML integration; Data residency requirement: US only for PII-containing docs; retention controls mandatory.

Integration notes: currently using Postgres + S3 for blob store and Pinecone as vector DB; exploring switching to self-hosted vector DB behind Redwood Dedicated or using Redwood-managed vector store with snapshot export.
Decision criteria: throughput per-dollar, VPC connectivity for Dedicated, rollback policy for model updates, SLAs for p95 latency.
Finance: Finance prefers 12-month committed pricing; Sales asked for ARR band estimate to model pricing tiers.
AE notes: Favorable CTO chemistry; SE will lead load testing and vet VPC setup.
